caption:
Did that hard thing really come out of nowhere? He always speaks before He acts. (Amos 3:7 devotional)

God never strikes without warning; He speaks to you first. His warning is never cruelty — it's a door still open.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Where have I called something ‘sudden’ that God had long been whispering about?
